documents.title: BM25 Ranking
documents.content: BM25 ranking improves simple TF-IDF search by using term frequency saturation and document length normalization. It is a strong default ranking algorithm for a practical search engine.

documents.title: TF-IDF Basics
documents.content: TF-IDF scores documents by combining term frequency inside one document with inverse document frequency across the full corpus.

documents.title: Inverted Index
documents.content: An inverted index maps each analyzed term to the documents that contain it. This avoids scanning every document for every search query.

documents.title: PostgreSQL Storage
documents.content: PostgreSQL stores source documents, URLs, job metadata, and index version records. The in-memory index is rebuilt from this source of truth.

documents.title: Wikipedia Crawler
documents.content: A Wikipedia crawler can fetch article titles, URLs, and page content, then pass those documents into the same indexing pipeline.

documents.title: Redis Search Cache
documents.content: Redis can cache repeated search responses using an index version in the cache key so old results do not survive after the corpus changes.
